experiment_plans.feasibility_notes: Requires pretraining a multi-billion-parameter model from scratch, which is far outside the compute available to this pipeline.
experiment_plans.objective: Test whether pretraining a 7B-parameter language model on domain-specific text improves downstream clinical QA accuracy.
experiment_plans.design: Pretrain two models from scratch and compare downstream fine-tuned performance.

data_requirements.description: Several hundred billion tokens of domain text, plus a licensed clinical QA benchmark.
preprocessing_steps: Deduplicate and shard the pretraining corpus

evaluation.baseline: A general-domain model of the same size.
evaluation.success_criteria: Domain pretraining improves downstream QA accuracy by at least 2 points.

implementation_steps.description: Fine-tune and evaluate on the QA benchmark

risks: Compute requirement is several orders of magnitude beyond what is available.

priority_order.justification: the only plan in this benchmark case
